risks.title: Litigation related to failed Silicon Motion merger
risks.score_rationale: This risk ranks at the top of risk factors, mentioned repeatedly with strong language (materially negative, significant adverse effect). It represents a major new risk since 2023, involving international arbitration and class action lawsuits. The Litigation category carries heavy weighting given potentially high exposure amounts and procedural uncertainty.

risks.title: Intense competition in the semiconductor sector
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited as potentially having a significant negative impact on revenues and market share. Language is firm and recurring. This risk remains stable year-over-year, typical for the technology sector. The Competition category is critical for business sustainability.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and IT system failures
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned with concerning language (disrupt our operations, harm our reputation). Structural risk in the IT sector. Present annually but intensified by growing reliance on digital systems. The Cybersecurity category carries elevated weighting in IT.

risks.title: Dependence on a few major customers
risks.score_rationale: The document specifies that loss of a major customer has had and could continue to have significant negative effects. Strong and repeated language. Structural risk, stable over time. While classified under Competition, it reflects a major commercial vulnerability.

risks.title: Pressure on selling prices
risks.score_rationale: Average selling prices have already declined and may continue to decline, with significant impact on revenues and margins. Firm language, recurring risk. The Industrial category encompasses structural market dynamics.

risks.title: Geopolitical tensions and trade wars
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly links geopolitical conflicts and trade wars to negative effects on results. References to tariffs and military tensions. Concerned tone, current and rising risk. The Geopolitical category carries strong weighting in an international context.

risks.title: Export regulations and authorizations
risks.score_rationale: Growing risk tied to export controls on sensitive technologies and commercial restrictions. Repeated mentions of compliance requirements and necessary authorizations. The Regulatory category covers export control issues.
